standard: Counter-UAS sensor export (radar plots, RF contacts), FAA LAANC-style authorisation list, logged sighting reports
entity_catalog: sensor_sites.csv in this folder (proposed for 06_data_streams/sensor_registry.json as drone_detection_sensors: see 06_data_streams/_internal/registry_additions_aviation.json); operator_id and airframe_id join drone_operators.json

files.sensor_sites.csv: the sensors: id, type, owner, position, nominal range, when they started reporting
files.sensor_status_YYYY-MM.csv: hourly health row per fixed sensor
files.detections_YYYY-MM.csv: radar plots (one row per plot, about every 4 seconds while a target is held) and RF contacts (one row per contact)
files.laanc_authorizations.csv: every authorisation issued to an operator, with time window and area
files.sighting_reports.csv: visual reports logged by security desks, police and the FAA

detections.name: track_id
detections.notes: the sensor's own track number; a new id starts when a target is lost for more than 40 seconds

detections.name: latitude / longitude / altitude_m
detections.notes: radar plots: target position and height. RF contacts from the airborne receiver: the aircraft's own position. Blank for bearing-only ground sensors.

detections.name: bearing_deg_true / range_m
detections.notes: from the sensor to the target (bearing only for RF contacts)

detections.name: remote_id
detections.notes: Remote ID or registration decoded or correlated for the target, when there is one

detections.name: authorization_id
detections.notes: authorisation the system matched to the target, when there is one; joins laanc_authorizations.csv

detections.name: classification / confidence
detections.notes: the sensor's automatic classification (bird, clutter, aircraft, uas, unknown, emitter type) and its confidence 0 to 1

detections.name: alert
detections.notes: true if the sensor raised an operator alert (radar: RCS at or above the sensor's alert threshold in sensor_sites.csv)

laanc_authorizations.name: authorization_type
laanc_authorizations.notes: LAANC, Certificate of Authorization, or Special Governmental Interest waiver (used while the hurricane flight restriction was in force)

sighting_reports.name: direction_deg
sighting_reports.notes: direction the witness was looking, degrees true, as estimated when logged

scenario_notes.coverage: 2027-08-15 to 2028-01-12. Three Coast Guard radar buoys along the ship channel and four perimeter sensors at NAS Corpus Christi report throughout (with outages); an airborne receiver logs contacts when its aircraft is flying; a seven-node RF network at port and utility sites starts reporting between 16 and 23 October 2027.
scenario_notes.what_sensors_see: Each sensor records what is within its range: birds, clutter, aircraft, and unmanned aircraft. Raw radar plots are archived whether or not they raised an alert.
scenario_notes.authorisations: Every flight in 05_other_sources/drone_video has an authorisation here.

sensor_sites_columns.sensor_id: sensor id used in detections and status files
sensor_sites_columns.name: site name
sensor_sites_columns.sensor_type: radar, RF direction finder, acoustic or camera
sensor_sites_columns.alert_rcs_threshold_m2: radar cross-section above which the site raises an alert (radars only)
